title: Volcanoes of Africa (hot and cold)
intro: 10 volcanoes of Africa, one after another. You have three tries for each place and are told warmer or colder after a miss. The map shows coasts, rivers, lakes and borders, and you work inside this area.

rounds.name: Ale Bagu
rounds.fact: Ale Bagu is a volcano with a recorded summit elevation of 1,031 m in the source data. The data places it in Ethiopia.

rounds.name: Hayli Gubbi
rounds.fact: Hayli Gubbi is a shield volcano; the latest significant eruption recorded for it in the source data was in 2025. The data places it in Ethiopia.
